source: Curated by AGEX. Every instruction skill is pinned to a commit and verified by SHA-256; every MCP server is pinned to a package version or is an official hosted endpoint.

skills.name: Systematic Debugging
skills.description: Find the root cause before fixing: reproduce, trace, form one hypothesis at a time, and prove the fix.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Test-Driven Development
skills.description: Write a failing test first, make it pass, then clean up. Keeps changes small and proven.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Verify Before Done
skills.description: Agents must run the checks and show the evidence before they say work is finished.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Writing Plans
skills.description: Turn a request into a step-by-step implementation plan with files, tests and checkpoints.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Executing Plans
skills.description: Work through a written plan task by task, checking each step before moving on.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: A structured review of finished work against its requirements, with issues ranked by severity.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)
skills.compatibility_note: Written for agents that can start a separate reviewer; other agents follow the same checklist themselves.

skills.name: Receiving Code Review
skills.description: Handle review feedback carefully: verify each suggestion before changing code, push back when it is wrong.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Finish a Branch
skills.description: When work is done and tests pass: choose how to integrate the branch (merge, pull request or cleanup) safely.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Git Worktrees
skills.description: Start feature work in a separate Git worktree so the main checkout stays untouched.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Caveman (short answers)
skills.description: Agents answer in compressed, fragment-style text that keeps technical detail: fewer output tokens, faster reading.
skills.author: Julius Brussee (Caveman)
skills.license: MIT (skills folder; engine and proxy are BSL-1.1 and not included)
skills.compatibility_note: Changes how agents write, not what they do. Its rules add about 1,000-1,500 input tokens per turn, so savings depend on how long the answers would have been.

skills.name: Caveman Commit Messages
skills.description: Short, precise commit messages in Conventional Commits style.
skills.author: Julius Brussee (Caveman)
skills.license: MIT (skills folder; engine and proxy are BSL-1.1 and not included)

skills.name: Caveman Code Review
skills.description: One-line review comments: location, problem, fix. No filler.
skills.author: Julius Brussee (Caveman)
skills.license: MIT (skills folder; engine and proxy are BSL-1.1 and not included)

skills.name: Repository Packer (Repomix)
skills.description: Packs a repository or folder into one compact, AI-friendly file with token counts. Its compress mode keeps only code structure (signatures, types) so agents read far fewer tokens.
skills.author: Kazuki Yamada (Repomix)
skills.compatibility_note: MCP servers are passed to Codex and Claude Code for each request. Antigravity and Gemini CLI read MCP servers only from their own settings, so AGEX does not pass it to them. The project states that compress mode reduces tokens by about 70%; AGEX has not measured this and the saving depends on the code.
skills.release_notes: Pinned npm version 1.18.1 (published 2026-09-21). Runs on this computer; it has a built-in secret scanner (Secretlint).

skills.name: Semantic Code Navigation (Serena)

skills.release_notes: Pinned PyPI version 1.7.0 of serena-agent (published 2026-08-09). Runs on this computer and may download language servers on first use.
skills.risk_note: Can edit files and run language servers.

skills.name: Windows Computer Use (Windows-MCP)

skills.author: CursorTouch
skills.compatibility_note: MCP servers are passed to Codex and Claude Code for each request. Antigravity and Gemini CLI read MCP servers only from their own settings, so AGEX does not pass it to them. Use it only with the Computer Operator team, and take control or stop from the workspace panel at any time.
skills.release_notes: Pinned PyPI version 0.8.5 (published 2026-08-01). Needs Python 3.13 through uv.
skills.risk_note: Full control of your desktop: it can click anything, type anywhere, run PowerShell and change files. The project warns it can perform irreversible operations. AGEX asks before every use.
